name: BotSubscriptionUpdated
description: This object contains information about changes to a user payment subscription toward the current bot.

fields.name: user
fields.description: User who subscribed for payments toward the bot

fields.name: state
fields.description: The new state of the subscription. Currently, it can be one of “canceled” if the user canceled the subscription, “active” if the user re-enabled a previously canceled subscription, or “failed” if payment for the subscription failed.
